title: Exact form of one simulator step
statement: Let $W$ and $M$ be finite binary Turing machines, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let a base schedule configuration, phase $q$, integers $u,g$, finite data state $d$, data tapes, and output word be given. Form the macrostep configuration $c$ from the base at phase $q$ with unary head $u$ and guide head $g$, and evaluate the data transducer on phase $q$, state $d$, the input symbol and schedule-tape reads of $c$, and the data-tape symbols at $g$. The simulator's one-step successor from the corresponding decorated configuration is exactly the decorated successor of the schedule controller's one-step successor from $c$, with the transducer's new finite state, its prescribed writes at $g$, and its prescribed output appended to the given output word.
